title: Turk asker oyunu scripst
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)

-- Ana Frame oluştur
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 700)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

-- Başlık ekleyelim
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.Text = "TA SCRIPTS V5 🔥"
title.TextSize = 24
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Genel buton oluşturma fonksiyonu
local function createButton(name, positionY, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Text = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, positionY)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Parent = mainFrame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- Face Değiştirme Butonları
createButton("FACE DEĞİŞTİRME", 60, function()
    local previousPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    -- Teleport to new position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(3090.3173828125, 35.504295349121094, -142.9991455078125)
    wait(2)
    -- Return to previous position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(previousPos)
end)

createButton("FACE DEĞİŞTİRME 2", 110, function()
    local previousPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    -- Teleport to new position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(3090.51611328125, 35.490943908691406, -138.48133850097656)
    wait(2)
    -- Return to previous position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(previousPos)
end)

createButton("FACE DEĞİŞTİRME-SUBAY ÖZEL-", 160, function()
    local previousPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    -- Teleport to new position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(3150.238037109375, 35.48134231567383, -196.97222900390625)
    wait(2)
    -- Return to previous position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(previousPos)
end)

createButton("SUBAY YERİ", 210, function()
    local previousPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    -- Teleport to new position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(3175.128173828125, 35.328208923339844, -207.05154418945312)
end)

-- DY-SORU CEVAB YERİ
createButton("DY-SORU CEVAB YERİ", 260, function()
    local previousPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    -- Teleport to new position
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(2839.852294921875, 11.418818473815918, 2335.7548828125)
end)

-- Silah ile TA+ASAK
createButton("SİLAH İLE TA+ASAK", 310, function()
    local tool1 = Instance.new("Tool", player.Backpack)
    tool1.Name = "PenisTool"
    tool1.RequiresHandle = true
    -- Customize tool handle and positioning if needed
end)

-- Özel Karakter V3
createButton("ÖZEL KARETER V3", 360, function()
    local animController = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if animController then
        local walkAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
        walkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://11416062386"
        local idleAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
        idleAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://12833974320"
        
        local runAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
        runAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://12834074729"
        animController:LoadAnimation(walkAnim):Play()
        animController:LoadAnimation(idleAnim):Play()
        animController:LoadAnimation(runAnim):Play()
    end
end)

-- Canavar Olma
createButton("CANAVAR OLMA .D", 410, function()
    local monsterAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    monsterAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://204295235"
    player.Character.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(monsterAnim):Play()
end)

-- Yavaş yürüme animasyonu
createButton("Yavaş Yürüme Animasyonu", 460, function()
    local slowWalkAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    slowWalkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://11307191489"
    player.Character.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(slowWalkAnim):Play()
end)

-- Normal yürüme ve koşma animasyonu
createButton("Normal Yürüme ve Koşma Animasyonu", 510, function()
    local walkAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    walkAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://11416062386"
    
    local runAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    runAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://12834074729"
    
    player.Character.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(walkAnim):Play()
    player.Character.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(runAnim):Play()
end)
